author: ShiftieNiftie
body:
I was banned for an 1 hour from TeamSpeak. GrapeSmoothie stated that A4 in the rule book was the reason he banned me. Though that is illogical. The rules do not read that i have to follow a directions of mod when the rule is not instigated. THere is not rule against changing the IGN. So there is an abuse of power. I want explanations of why it is that mods and mapdevs keep using A4 as a diversion to the abuse of power. The reason I change my IGN is because people make fun of me badly.
Sincerely,
CaptainMellow
